name: com.gameframex.unity.ui.ugui
description:
GameFrameX UI UGUI — UGUI adapter for the GameFrameX UI package. Instantiates prefab-based forms, organizes UI groups as Canvas layers with depth sorting, auto-initializes the UGUI runtime root, drives show / hide animations through handlers, and self-registers as the default UI helper backend through the backend registry (custom Func factories in UIOptions take priority). Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX UI UGUI — GameFrameX UI 包的 UGUI 适配层。实例化预制体界面、以 Canvas 分层组织界面组并深度排序、自动初始化 UGUI 运行时根节点、经 Handler 驱动显示/隐藏动画，并经后端注册表自注册为默认 UI Helper 后端（UIOptions 中的自定义 Func 工厂优先）。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
